notes: Manufacturer datasheet (Bluesound-Professional-B100S-Data-Sheet.pdf) confirms all physical connectors and shows the rear-panel diagram. No bandwidth-graded connectors are present (RJ45 is Gigabit Ethernet per connectivity table -> eth-1g grade applied; USB ports are legacy USB 2.0-class ports used for mass storage/servicing, not graded since no explicit spec version is stated by the datasheet, so grade omitted per rules requiring an explicit stated version — though the "USB memory sticks / Type-A" wording combined with a 2019-era ARM Cortex-A9 platform strongly implies USB 2.0; left ungraded to avoid unconfirmed grade). AC power input is described as "Universal bi-pin AC Cord input (100-240AC)" and the rear-panel diagram shows a round 2-pin recessed inlet — this is a figure-8/bi-pin style connector, mapped to iec-c7 (closest catalog match) rather than standard IEC C13/C14. IR IN and 12V TRIG IN are low-voltage control terminals on a pluggable barrier/phoenix-style strip, mapped to euroblock (closest connector in the allowed list; IR uses "ir" id, trigger uses euroblock terminal). Unit is a 1/3-rack-width desktop/shelf device (three units share 1U via optional RM100 rack shelf) — not itself a full rack-mountable RU device, so rackUnits omitted per instructions (only optional accessory converts it to rack use).

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Type-A port for USB memory sticks (FAT32/NTFS) and supported peripherals

ports.name: SERVICE
ports.note: Type-B mini port for product servicing

ports.name: LINE/MIC IN
ports.note: Balanced stereo (L/R + GND) pluggable barrier-strip/Phoenix terminal; phantom power switchable for mic input

ports.name: LINE OUT
ports.note: Balanced analog stereo (L/R + GND) pluggable barrier-strip/Phoenix terminal output

ports.name: SUBW OUT
ports.note: Dedicated balanced line-level subwoofer output on pluggable barrier-strip/Phoenix terminal

ports.name: TRIG IN
ports.note: 12V trigger input terminal (labeled +12V TRIG IN on rear panel)

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: Universal bi-pin (figure-8 style) AC cord input, 100-240V 50/60Hz; closest catalog match to the round 2-pin captive/bi-pin inlet shown on rear panel
